translationRepairs: Some years later he was promoted to superintendent of waterways and parks, leapfrogging the commandant of justice.
Several years later, he was promoted to Superintendent of Waterways and Parks, then advanced exceptionally to Commandant of Justice.

數年，遷水衡都尉，超過廷尉 pairs exceptional advancement (超, as in the preceding 超遷) with appointment as 廷尉, not skipping that office; later 為廷尉十八歲 and 于定國為廷尉 confirm he held it. The original “leapfrogging” invents a bypass.
Some years later he was promoted superintendent of waterways and parks, passing over the commandant of justice.
Several years later, he was promoted to Superintendent of Waterways and Parks, then advanced exceptionally to Commandant of Justice.
超過廷尉 means he was exceptionally advanced to commandant of justice; “passing over” reverses the sense. The repair matches the Chinese offices and the exceptional-promotion idiom.
